LanguageData.ASE_DoubleReactorCapacity.label: double reactor capacity
LanguageData.ASE_DoubleReactorCapacity.description: Engineers increased the reactor capacity, but this slightly affects movement speed.
LanguageData.ASE_EMPGenerator.label: EMP reactor
LanguageData.ASE_EMPGenerator.description: This experimental reactor produces a decent amount of energy, but its core periodically provokes EMP bursts that can negatively affect other androids and mechanisms.
LanguageData.ASE_ExperimentalQuantumReactor.label: experimental quantum reactor
LanguageData.ASE_ExperimentalQuantumReactor.descripti: An increased-power reactor, but the reformatting time is tripled.
LanguageData.ASE_VanometricReactor.label: vanometric reactor
LanguageData.ASE_VanometricReactor.description: An unstable prototype capable of generating an incredible amount of energy at the cost of an equally incredible amount of waste.
LanguageData.ASE_TestReactor.label: test reactor [DEBUG]
LanguageData.ASE_TestReactor.description:
Test reactor for debugging. Provides huge amount of energy. (Hidden from players)

Effects:
+1000 power efficiency
LanguageData.ASE_HandmadeEnergyBooster.label: handmade reactor
LanguageData.ASE_HandmadeEnergyBooster.description: Hand-assembled and extremely fragile experimental reactor provides incredible power efficiency and work speed, but the android cannot be repaired after damage.
LanguageData.ASE_ExperimentalMechanoidReactor.label: experimental mechanoid reactor
LanguageData.ASE_ExperimentalMechanoidReactor.descrip: Further increasing the reactor's energy efficiency led to an unexpected effect - its high frequency attracts other mechanoids.
